name: Takanashi Kazuma
source:
The protagonist of Making Lovers; extremely bad with romance, he has no interest in finding a girlfriend, claiming that he's waiting for a "destined meeting". 

His biological parents tragically passed away in an accident when he was young, and was adopted by Ako's parents.

After being scolded by everyone in his social-circle (including his parents) but being supported by his sister (Ako) , he reluctantly took a step forward, and accepts his friend's invitation to mixer-event.
